name: NetBar
author: lugossi
description: See every port you have left listening, which project opened it, whether it is exposed to the network, and kill it from the bar.

barWidget.description: Listening ports, the processes holding them, and a kill switch.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to rescan while the panel is closed. The panel polls every 2s while open.

schema.label: Include UDP sockets
schema.description: UDP listeners are mostly mDNS and DNS chatter, so they are hidden by default.

schema.label: Notify when a new port opens
schema.description: Send a desktop notification the first time a dev server appears on a port.

schema.label: Show system and other-user ports
schema.description: Include listeners you cannot kill, such as sshd and cupsd. Toggle per-session with 's'.

schema.label: Hide the widget when nothing is listening
schema.description: Keep the bar clean and only surface NetBar when a dev server is actually up.

schema.label: Offer to enable Docker access
schema.description: Show a one-click grant when Docker is running but unreadable. Installs a narrow sudo rule for a single helper, not docker-group membership.
